_meta.note: Version 3.1 uses simplified Android intent format. Default values: grant_uri_permission=true, clear_task=true, mime_type='application/octet-stream'. rom_delivery: 'intent_data' (ROM as intent data), 'extra' (ROM via extras array), 'none' (no ROM).

files.name: inis/PCSX2.ini
files.content:
[UI]
SetupWizardIncomplete = false
SettingsVersion = 1

[Filenames]
BIOS = ps2-0200a-20040614.bin

[MemoryCards]
Slot1_Enable = true
Slot1_Filename = main.ps2

files.name: melonDS.toml
files.content:
[Emu]
ConsoleType = 1
DirectBoot = true

[DS]
FirmwarePath = "{emulator_dir}/firmware.bin"
BIOS7Path = "{emulator_dir}/bios7.bin"
BIOS9Path = "{emulator_dir}/bios9.bin"

[DSi]
FullBIOSBoot = false
FirmwarePath = "{emulator_dir}/dsi/firmware.bin"
BIOS9Path = "{emulator_dir}/dsi/bios9.bin"
BIOS7Path = "{emulator_dir}/dsi/bios7.bin"
NANDPath = "{emulator_dir}/dsi/nand.bin"
